svg.title: Next research objective
svg.desc: Develop a prototype neural network surrogate tailored to Great Lakes wave-ice processes and, once reference data are available, evaluate its predictive performance and computational cost against an existing numerical model.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: The next research objective is to develop a prototype neural network surrogate for Great Lakes
wave-ice processes and, once reference data are available, evaluate its predictive performance
and computational cost against an existing numerical model.
